sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Shared slide frame setup
sections.what: Brings in the house colours, font, confidential text, and wordmark, and states what the frame provides: the title with its single red rule, the status tags, the source line, and the footer.
sections.why: The header comment states the purpose: consistent content slides, with the title slide kept separate.
sections.watch_out: The title slide has its own layout, so changing this frame does not change it.

sections.name: HouseSlideChrome (part 1)
sections.title: Slide header with title and tags
sections.what: Draws the top of each slide: the large title with an optional smaller subtitle on the left, and status tags such as PRELIMINARY on the right, separated by red slashes. An extra area under the tags can hold items such as the project count or a regenerate button.
sections.why: The code shows this is the shared header for every slide, so the look stays the same across the deck.
sections.watch_out: A very long title wraps and can squeeze the space left for the tags, so keep titles short.

sections.name: HouseSlideChrome (part 2)
sections.title: Slide body, footer and page number
sections.what: Places a thin red rule under the header, then the slide's own content, then an optional footnote, a Source line, the confidential footer, the house wordmark and the page number at the bottom.
sections.why: The comments say the red rule is the only rule on the slide and that the footer sits at the bottom of every content slide, so this chrome is defined once here.
sections.watch_out: The Source line always prints the word Source followed by whatever text is passed in, so an empty source shows as a bare label.

summary: The shared frame for Benchmark Scan content slides, providing the House title, status tags, source line, and confidential footer around each slide's body.
purpose: Gives every content slide the same look, so the deck looks consistent.
why: The header comment says every content slide uses this frame. The title slide has its own layout.
how: Reading the visible notes: the frame sets a white background and house font, draws a black title with the single red rule beneath it, places grey status tags with red separators at the top right, adds a grey source line, and ends with a confidential footer carrying the wordmark and page number. Slide content is passed in as children.
inputs: Props used by the slides include title, subtitle, tags, source, page, headerRight, footnote, testId, and children (the slide body).
outputs: A framed slide that wraps the body content.
risks: Only the first section of this file was provided, so the footer and prop handling have not been checked.
debug: If a slide looks unstyled, check the imports from the house theme file. If the page number is missing, check the page prop passed by the slide.
